description.en: Bulgaria's vibrant capital blends 7,000 years of history with modern energy. Explore Roman ruins beneath city streets, majestic Alexander Nevsky Cathedral, trendy neighbourhoods, excellent restaurants and Vitosha Mountain just minutes away.

description.en: Europe's oldest continuously inhabited city and 2019 European Capital of Culture. Discover the Ancient Roman theatre, the charming Old Town with Revival-era houses, vibrant arts scene and the famous Kapana creative quarter.
description.bg: Най-старият непрекъснато обитаван град в Европа и Европейска столица на културата 2019. Античен театър, Стар град с възрожденски къщи и творчески квартал Капана.

description.en: The maritime capital of Bulgaria on the Black Sea coast. Home to the world's oldest processed gold, stunning Sea Garden, vibrant nightlife, excellent seafood restaurants and beautiful beaches.

description.en: Gateway to the southern Black Sea coast with a beautiful sea garden, pedestrian centre, nearby lakes and wetlands, and easy access to Sozopol, Nessebar and Sunny Beach.

description.en: The medieval capital of the Second Bulgarian Empire perched dramatically on three hills above the Yantra River. Visit the Tsarevets fortress, Samovodska Charshia crafts street and enjoy spectacular sound and light shows.

description.en: The "Little Vienna" of Bulgaria on the Danube River, known for elegant Neo-Baroque and Neo-Rococo architecture, vibrant cultural scene, the Danube Bridge to Romania and nearby Ivanovo rock churches.
